title: Full Transparency: 1-Year Performance
author: Significant-Lion5275
selftext:
Hey guys,  
I wanted to be 100% transparent and share the yearly performance of our trading software.  
As you can see, the system is performing incredibly well, especially for clearing and managing Prop Firm accounts hehe! ;))  
 To keep everything fully trackable, we just launched a new VIP Dashboard that displays all monthly performance data and metrics time.  
If you wanna read about it how it works in detail you can read it all here on our website: https://onenesstraders.com/

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: a dashboard you host yourself isn't transparency though, you can edit it. a verified third-party link or the actual broker statements would land a lot better here, with the worst month shown next to the best.
